::: {#def-bca-bias-correction}
#### Bias correction of the BCa interval

For a statistic $\hat\theta$ and its bootstrap replicates
$\hat\theta^*_1, \ldots, \hat\theta^*_B$,
the **bias correction** is

$$\hat{z}_0 \eqdef \Phi^{-1}\paren{\frac{\#\cb{b : \hat\theta^*_b < \hat\theta}}{B}},$$

where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian CDF.
:::
